name: io.github.GeiserX/cashpilot-mcp
title: CashPilot
description: MCP server for CashPilot: track passive income and DePIN earnings, manage services

environmentVariables.name: CASHPILOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: CashPilot API key: the admin key (CASHPILOT_ADMIN_API_KEY) for full control, or the read-only key (CASHPILOT_READONLY_API_KEY) together with CASHPILOT_READ_ONLY=1. Not the fleet key.

environmentVariables.name: CASHPILOT_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true (or 1) to register only the tools that change nothing (no start, stop, restart, deploy, remove or collection)

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Runs the image on stdio instead of its default HTTP listener
